subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a narrow 24-hour Cron timeline in the core Control UI after this PR is rebased and the scheduler/status/i18n blockers are fixed, or should the broader calendar/week/editing request stay in product design?
rationale: The linked issue asks for a broader calendar/timeline product surface, and this PR implements a narrower feature slice while also crossing current Control UI architecture and cron status contracts.

options.title: Adopt a narrow timeline slice
options.body: Accept a rebased 24-hour timeline as the first core Control UI slice once it preserves current contracts and aligns with scheduler behavior.

options.title: Keep design open only
options.body: Close or pause this implementation and keep the canonical issue open until maintainers decide the full calendar/week/editing UX.

options.title: Request a replacement PR
options.body: Ask for a new PR against the current `ui/src/pages/cron` architecture instead of continuing to repair this stale branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow timeline slice
recommendation.body: Accept a rebased 24-hour timeline as the first core Control UI slice once it preserves current contracts and aligns with scheduler behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The product decision is tied to the current Control UI architecture refactor path that this PR must now target.
